svg.text: Packing: from row-major matrix to microkernel contiguous read order
Generic B example (K x N, row-major)
Split into panels of 16 columns (shown as 8), last block zero-padded
Pre-packed B: panel i stored as K rows x 16 cols contiguous
Microkernel reads 64 bytes sequentially per k-step, strictly increasing addresses, hardware prefetch friendly
Packed A: one panel per 6 rows, interleaved as [k][6]
Numbers are row indices: 6 A values for k-step p are adjacent for 6 broadcasts
RMSNorm writes (input x inverse) x scale at this step, no materialized normalization matrix
